description.value: An ordered exchange of set problems put to a visiting household before a pit is opened in its presence, with answers that are fixed and known to everybody who has ever been asked. Getting one wrong does not stop the opening; getting one right is how a household establishes that it may be present at all.

content.value:
What sits in the dark four years and comes out with a name it did not go in with? The third stage.

What is mine, and is not mine, and will be my daughter's? The culture.

What is thrown away by the one who wanted it most? The top layer.

What is opened once and never opened again? A pit opened early.

Who may stand at the rim? Whoever has answered four.

notes.value: The survey has answered four on three occasions and has been permitted to stand at the rim each time. It has never been asked a fifth, and the fifth is not, on the evidence, a question.
